name: metr_point_v0_observed_key_prior
rationale: The final temporal cross-attention head 3 assigns almost all mass to unobserved keys. Use the exact LayerNorm affine invariant to add a constant query toward the learned key-space observed-vs-unknown contrast, increasing its mean observed-key log odds by log(4). Only input masks and internal keys were used, no targets or fitted loss. This tests whether that extreme preference for imputed keys is harmful; it is not presumed a bug.
